title: A letter to Grandad
text:
Jalan Mawar 12
Bandung
14 March

Dear Grandad,

Thank you for the drawing book you sent for my birthday. I have already filled ten pages!

Last week, my class went on a trip to a tea garden in the hills. We rode in a bus for an hour, and the road twisted round and round like a snake. When we got there, the air was cool and fresh. Rows of tea bushes covered the hills like a green blanket.

A tea picker called Pak Harto showed us how to pick the leaves. He only picks the top two leaves and the bud, because they are the youngest and softest. I picked a whole basket! Well, half a basket. It was much harder than it looked.

At the end, we tasted the tea. I thought it would be bitter, but it was mild and smelt a little like flowers.

I have drawn the tea garden in my new book. I will show it to you when you visit in the holidays.

With lots of love,
Bima
